mapper.select:
select TRIM(t.SECURITYID)|| '.IB' secid, t.SETTLCURRENCY ccy, DECODE(t.SIDE, '1', 'P', 'S') ps, t.PRICE price8, t.YIELD2 yield8, t.STRIKEYIELD strikeyield, t.DIRTYPRICE dirtyprice, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTAMT accruedinterestamt, t.SETTLTYPE settleSpeed, t.LASTQTY prinamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT settamt, t.OURTRADERNAME trad, t.COUNTERTRADERNAME clienttrader, t.COUNTERTELEPHONE countertelephone, t.OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER ourdepositaccountnumber, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTAMT unitInt, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTTOTALAMT convintamt, 'E' effectflag, to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') inputdate, TO_DATE(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') dealdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') settdate, DECODE(t.EXECTYPE, '4', to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') revdate, 1 updatecounter, t.EXECID fedealno, t.TEXT dealtext, t.UPDATETIME lstmntdate, t.CLEARINGMETHOD clearingmethod, t.DELIVERYTYPE deliverytype, t.COUNTERINSTITUTIONCODE cno
from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.updatetime = (select max(t.updatetime) from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, 'H01', 10, 'H03', '') prodtype, TRIM(t.SECURITYID) secid, DECODE(t.SIDE, '4', 'RS', 'RB') ps, 'N' crtrevdealstatus, 'IB' market, 0 ismanaul, 'O' clienttype, TO_DATE(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') dealdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') vdate, TO_DATE(t.SETTLDATE2, 'YYYYMMDD') mdate, CASE WHEN t.TRADELIMITDAYS IS NOT NULL THEN t.TRADELIMITDAYS ELSE t.settldate2 - t.SETTLDATE END term,
t.SETTLCURRENCY ccy, t.PRICE reporate, 'A/365' basis, DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, t.ACCRUEDINTERESTTOTALAMT, 10, t.SETTLCURRAMT2 - t.SETTLCURRAMT) repointamt, DECODE(t.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, t.TRADECASHAMT, 10, t.SETTLCURRAMT) repoamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT vdealamt, t.SETTLCURRAMT2 mdealamt, DECODE(t.DELIVERYTYPE, 0, 'DVP', 4, 'PUD', 5, 'DUP') vclrform, DECODE(t.DELIVERYTYPE2, 0, 'DVP', 4, 'PUD', 5, 'DUP') mclrform, t.COUNTERTRADERNAME selltrader, t.TEXT dealtext, DECODE(t.EXECTYPE, '4', to_date(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') revdate, t.UPDATETIME lstmntdate, 'E' effectflag, t.LASTQTY facetotalamt, t.COUNTERINSTITUTIONCODE seller, t.SECURITYID termType, t.CB_FPRICE_AMT, t.SC_FPRICE_AMT, t.OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER ourdepositaccountnumber, CASE WHEN t.SETTLDATE = t.TRADEDATE THEN '1' ELSE '2' END settleSpeed, t.CASHHOLDINGDAYS cashHoldingDays from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.updatetime = (select max(t.updatetime) from interf_cstp_trade t where t.execid = #{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = #{businesstype,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select PORTFOLIO_ID from
IBU_QUOTE_BOND
IBU_QUOTE_CREP
where CFETS_QUOTE_ID = #{quoteid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select mcp.COUNTER_ID from MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp INNER JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci ON mcp.PARTY_ID = mcci.PARTY_ID WHERE mcci.PARTY_ID = #{cpPartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN IBU_PORTFOLIO_ACCT_RELA T2 ON T2.PARTY_ID = T1.PARTY_ID WHERE T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL
AND T1.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = #{ourinstitutioncode}
select t.pre_trade_id as preTradeId from trdquto_match_info t where t.exe_id=#{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.match_status ='01' and rownum=1
select t.pre_trade_id as preTradeId from trdquto_match_info t where t.CSTP_TRADE_ID=#{cstpTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.match_status ='01' and rownum=1

select ib.quote_date as tradeDate, ib.finprod_id as finprodId, fp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, ib.ps as ps, decode(ib.settle_speed,0,'01',1,'02',2,'03') as settleSpeed, ib.sec_manage_acct_id as secManageAcctId, ibd.yield as tradeYield, nvl(ib.share_amt,0)*100 as faceValue, ib.settle_date as settleDate, ib.delivery_type as deliveryType, ib.quote_id as totleTradeId from ibu_quote_bond ib left join ( select I.* from ibu_quote_bond_det I INNER JOIN (SELECT quote_id ,MAX(update_time) UPDATETIME FROM ibu_quote_bond_det GROUP BY quote_id) II ON I.quote_id = II.quote_id AND II.UPDATETIME = I.Update_Time )ibd on ib.quote_id=ibd.quote_id left join fin_product fp on ib.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id where ib.quote_id =#{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into trdquto_match_info (SEQNO, CSTP_TRADE_ID, EXE_ID, PRE_TRADE_ID, MATCH_TYPE, MATCH_STATUS, TRD_CONF_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values (#{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cstpTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{exeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{preTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{matchType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{matchStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trdConfStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},sysdate )
mapper.update: update trdquto_match_info set match_type= #{matchType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, match_status= #{matchStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_USER= #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = sysdate where PRE_TRADE_ID=#{preTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
